title: Schöne App
body:
Die App ist sehr schön designed und gut gemacht, der Preis für die Vollversion sehr fair und die eingeschränkte Version hat auch keine Werbung.

Das einzige was noch nicht perfekt funktioniert ist das umordnen des layouts wenn man viele Boards hat, da die Ansicht „einfriert“ sobald man in den Layout modus wechselt und man dann zb an die untersten Boards nicht rankommt und sie nicht einfach zb ganz nach oben schieben kann. Es geht aber trotzdem, ist nur umständlich.

Als Feature würde ich mir sonst noch wünschen, dass man Boards auch als „negativ“ einstellen kann, sodass unerfüllte Tage in Folge als Serie/Konsistenz gewertet werden, statt umgekehrt.

Eine import-funktion um Daten aus einer Datei (die man einfach selbst erstellen kann) importieren zu können, wäre super um vergangene Daten einzupflegen.

Insgesamt aber immernoch die beste Tracking App die ich finden konnte👏

Overall, it’s a fantastic app that I can highly recommend.

title: Requests
body:
Hello!

I would like to say a big thank you for the Ripples app—I really like it. I use it actively, it helps me track my habits and motivates me to keep going. Great job 🙌

I would like to offer a few ideas/improvements that I think could make the app even more convenient and intuitive:

1. Annual statistics
It would be great to see not only a visual representation in the annual statistics, but also the total number of times the habit was performed during the year — that is, how many times the action was performed during that period.

2. Annual grid of 365 cells
Currently, the app has a grid (112 cells), and it looks very clear. It would be great to also add an annual grid of 365 cells so that you can see the whole year at once — similar to the current view, but in an annual format.

I would be very happy if you would consider these suggestions and perhaps add them in future updates.  
I really like the app and plan to purchase a subscription.

Thank you for your work and for such a great app!

author: AbiSheico

title: Beautifully designed
body:
Updated (6/9/26)
Appreciate the updates. Keeps improving. Particularly like the new compact minimalist view. 

Few more requests:
- Time elapsed since last entry. (Relative dates)
- Photo attachments to journal entries would be a nice touch. 
- Still needs some kind of categorizing capability to filter/search in a long list or spotlight integration at least. Scrolling through a long list gets tedious when you have many things to track. 
- Reiterate the importance of an Apple Watch app to complete the experience.

Previous:
Just Needs filtering — Categories or tags (preferably) and an Apple Watch app. 

Other than that it’s quite appealing.
